name: jravis
description: Voice and text driven second-brain automation platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,mobile -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @jravis/api" "npm run dev -w @jravis/web" "npm run dev -w @jravis/mobile"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @jravis/api" "npm run dev -w @jravis/web"
scripts.build:core: npm run build -w @jravis/contracts && npm run build -w @jravis/brain-core && npm run build -w @jravis/policy-engine && npm run build -w @jravis/mcp-gateway
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @jravis/api && npm run build -w @jravis/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
